call_points.text: Sees operating EBITDA margin expanding from 7.5% to a 15% handle over four years.
Marketing spend to fall from 6.6% of revenue to 4.5-4.6% over five years.
Same-store sales growth was 39% in Q1FY27, broad-based across cohorts.
More than 80% of sales originate online; stores convert that intent.
Pre-Ind AS EBITDA margin at 7.5%, up 273 bps, on operating leverage.
Gold price volatility and the duty hike to 15% softened May demand; management prefers stable gold.
Below-store costs add 5.1pp: A&P efficiency +2.0pp and corporate cost leverage +3.1pp.
A&P spend rises from ₹155 Cr to ₹552 Cr but falls from 6.6% to 4.6% of revenue.
Corporate costs rise from ₹108 Cr to ₹192 Cr while falling from 4.6% to 1.6% of revenue.
Stores typically reach operational break-even in 3-4 months; footprint is planned to expand 20% over five years.
54% of stores (185) are less than three years old; 155 are older than three years.
Revenue from repeat customers rose from 32% in FY22 to 54.5% in FY26.
Same-store sales growth stood at 34% in Q4, demonstrating a resilient demand environment.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹681.47 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹32.03 Cr.
BlueStone released its Monitoring Agency Report for Q4FY26 on 23 April 2026, showing ₹56.63 crore unutilised IPO proceeds.
Q4FY26 standalone results (press release): revenue ₹687.7 Cr, up 49.1% YoY; adjusted EBITDA ₹147.4 Cr at 21.4% margin; FY26 reported PAT ₹26.0 Cr, the first full year of profit.
Gaurav Singh Kushwaha, Managing Director, shared Q4 FY 2025-26 earnings call recording on April 24, 2026, via www.bluestone.com.
BlueStone filed its Q4 FY26 earnings call transcript on April 29, 2026, reporting robust 34% SSG and 340 total stores.

On 1 June 2026 BlueStone disclosed postal ballot results: shareholders passed both special resolutions, a one-time special bonus and an increase in remuneration for MD and Chairman Gaurav Singh Kushwaha, with 97.39% and 99.9954% of votes polled in favour.
BlueStone announced its Investor Day 2026 strategic roadmap, guiding for ₹12,000 Cr revenue and 25% ROE by FY2030.
On 4 June 2026 BlueStone filed a revised Investor Day 2026 presentation, correcting four slides and setting FY30 targets of ₹12,000 Cr revenue, 25% ROE and 14.7% pre-IndAS EBITDA margin.
On 21 July 2026, BlueStone held its Q1FY27 earnings call, reporting 49% revenue growth to ₹733 Cr and guiding to ₹12,000 Cr revenue in four years.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹745.03 Cr (+45.1% YoY), net loss to shareholders ₹3.23 Cr (against a loss of ₹51.75 Cr a year earlier).
BlueStone board approved raising up to ₹300 Cr via non-convertible debentures.
BlueStone reported Q2FY27 revenue of ₹738 Cr up 43.9% YoY and EBITDA of ₹97.1 Cr up 127% YoY, crossing 1 million customers.
BlueStone Jewellery and Lifestyle Limited made the Q2 FY 2026-27 earnings discussion recording available on its website on 23 October 2026.
BlueStone paid a ₹4,000 fine to NSE for a two-day delay in filing the Q1FY27 shareholding pattern.
